summary: Added the `ledger_ping` MCP tool as a lightweight (~50-token) health-check alternative to `ledger_help` (~2,000 tokens). The tool returns reachability status, running server version, stale-instance detection, and uptime. The PM persona preflight partial was updated to use `ledger_ping` instead of `ledger_help`, so agents now catch stale servers at the very start of a run with explicit `stale` field checking rather than inferring health from a successful documentation response.
